title: A Purpose-Built Open Source Liquid Handler for Industry-Class Automated Experiments
protocol_category: turbidostat / continuous culture; pipetting accuracy calibration
results_evidence: OLH pipetting MAE 4.1 vs 7.2 uL manual (p<0.005); closed-loop turbidostat held ~200 cultures at OD setpoints.
readiness_reason: PyLabRobot code for a custom open liquid handler (OLH) + Byonoy reader; no license on turbidostat repo; full build package promised on publication; simulation needs custom backend.

title: Autonomous liquid-handling robotics scripting through large language models enables accessible and safe protein engineering workflows
protocol_category: LLM protocol generation; cell-free GFP variant characterisation; enzyme screening; fluorescence calibration
results_evidence: Fluorescence standard curves CV<5%, R2>0.999; 318 GFP variants characterised (best 5.0x avGFP); enzyme double mutants >3x catalytic efficiency.
readiness_reason: Repo is an LLM agent/tooling, not the executed protocol scripts; no license; experiments span OT-2, Flex, Hamilton Vantage, Tecan Fluent; executed scripts would need extraction. Also a competitor system to Text2WetLab (useful as related work).
